decision: Adopt MUSCL2+local-HLL+SSPRK2 for 1-D SWE dam-break validation
hypothesis: Second-order MUSCL reconstruction with minmod limiter, Davis local-speed HLL flux, and SSP-RK2 (Heun) time integration achieves <15% error vs Ritter (1892) analytical solution for dry-bed dam break
metrics: C2: Profile L2 error vs Ritter < 15%
baseline: Ritter (1892) self-similar solution: x_f = 2*sqrt(g*h0)*t, h(x,t) = (2*c0 - x/t)^2/(9*g)
stopping_rule: All three criteria must pass at nx >= 400; report all resolutions
confounders: Threshold-based front detection is sensitive to numerical diffusion; mass-based front estimator is physically robust
Dry-bed treatment: h=0 in dry cells, positivity fallback (alpha 1->0.5->0) prevents negative depth
repetition_rationale: Four resolutions to demonstrate monotonic convergence
external_anchor: Ritter (1892) Z. Ver. Deutsch. Ing. 36 947; Martin & Moyce (1952) Phil. Trans. R. Soc. A 244 312
